blocks.text: # Proofpress Provenance Lineage Evaluation
## Review status

This directory records immutable transport-history slices and the accepted Gateway-first follow-up. New formal work uses Vercel AI Gateway with the exact `deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731` slug; the prior OpenRouter/Novita and unversioned-Flash smoke records remain auditable operational history only. Harvey LAB remains the task and scoring substrate; Proofpress is evaluated as an artifact-native history layer, not as a second benchmark.
## The research question
For difficult Harvey legal tasks, does artifact-native Proofpress lineage improve a SAS agent with ordinary continuity, under the same task and budget?

The study is deliberately not a claim that more context or more agents are better. It tests whether work artifacts can carry authority, source status, rationale, and acceptance state **in addition to** normal coordination state, without turning Proofpress into a separate handoff note or requiring teams to abandon ordinary memory.
## Scope and comparison

The execution runtime is [Harvey LAB](https://github.com/harveyai/harvey-labs) v1.0's own task and scoring harness. Harvey tasks are not inherently agent-to-agent handoff tasks; our wrapper creates the controlled long-horizon workflow. One orchestrator role (in fresh planning and review sessions) coordinates evidence, decision-register, and drafting stages. Each completed stage emits a real work artifact, producing `V0 → V1 → V2 → V3 → V4` rather than one artificial two-agent transfer.
The active formal contrast has two explicitly scoped SAS arms:

- `C0 sas-ordinary`: one agent completes the original Harvey task with ordinary continuity.
- `C3 sas-proofpress`: the same SAS task flow, source workspace, tools, and billable-token cap; material artifact checkpoints additionally carry admitted Proofpress lineage and are independently verified.

The primary causal contrast is `C3 sas-proofpress − C0 sas-ordinary`. C1/C2 centralized-MAS arms remain a separately declared architecture extension; their incomplete OpenRouter/Novita matrix is frozen and is not the next estimand or a source of pooled results.
## What is here today

- `docs/RESEARCH_PLAN.md` — accepted follow-up protocol, observed Gate 1 boundary, arms, metrics, and gates.
- `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` — the fixed centralized workflow and the treatment boundary.
- `docs/EXECUTION_PLAN.md` — staged implementation and run plan, including explicit stopping gates.
- `docs/RESULTS_MATRIX.md` — the three result matrices and how to interpret them.
- `docs/RUNBOOK.md` — operational prerequisites and what is or is not implemented today.
- `docs/ARA_PROOFPRESS.md` — ARA as research-management layer; Proofpress as independently verifiable artifact lineage.
- `ara/` — an Agent-Native Research Artifact for this study. It contains hypotheses and decisions, not invented results.
- `configs/gate-native-v1.draft.yaml` — a historical three-arm MAS draft, not the active Gateway contract.
- `pp_eval/`, `suites/`, and `tests/` — the pre-existing lightweight mechanism runtime. It is retained for smoke tests and does not yet claim to execute the official Harvey harness treatment wrapper.
## ARA installation

The official ARA source has been cloned at `third_party/ara-source` and its six local Codex skills were installed under `.codex/skills/`. Both locations are ignored by Git; their source URL, commit, installation command, and role are recorded in [ara/UPSTREAM.md](ara/UPSTREAM.md). ARA is the research-management layer only. Benchmark agents never receive its files, skills, or prompts.
## Before any model run

The completed Gate 1a/1b results are retained as evidence about an **external transport prototype** only. Before a formal run, qualify the Gateway adapter with one Harvey SAS workflow per C0/C3 arm, then freeze and run two tasks × C0/C3 × three attempts (12 workflows). Every model call must record the requested and resolved model, actual provider, Gateway-reported `usage.cost`, token/latency values, and fallback status/metadata. A missing field is audit-visible but disqualifies that workflow from the formal matrix; local `$0` is never a cost substitute. After Harvey, run STATE-Bench and MemConflict as independent C0/C3 reports, then pass HiEviDR-Bench and DeepResearch Bench adapter/scorer gates before their own independent slices.
## Existing lightweight smoke runtime
The existing `pp-eval` commands still work for local fixture validation:

```bash
export PROOFPRESS_EVAL_HOME=/Users/richardtang/.cache/proofpress-eval
cd /Users/richardtang/proofpress-dev/experiments/provenance_handoff
uv sync --frozen
uv run pp-eval doctor --suite smoke-v1 --data-home "$PROOFPRESS_EVAL_HOME"
uv run pp-eval build --suite smoke-v1 --data-home "$PROOFPRESS_EVAL_HOME"
uv run pp-eval run --suite smoke-v1 --data-home "$PROOFPRESS_EVAL_HOME" --arms final,proofpress --runner codex --model gpt-5.6-terra --attempts 1 --concurrency 1
uv run pp-eval grade --suite smoke-v1 --data-home "$PROOFPRESS_EVAL_HOME"
uv run pp-eval report --suite smoke-v1 --data-home "$PROOFPRESS_EVAL_HOME"
```
Those fixtures validate package construction, isolation, recording, and reports only. They are not a substitute for the Harvey-first study described in `docs/`.
